sample_unit: trials (45 synthetic vignettes x 3 prompt variants)

links.outcome: Calibration of LLM confidence against accuracy and evidence strength in diagnostic vignettes
links.effect: Accuracy 93.5%, mean confidence 78.4%, AUROC2 0.876. Confidence tracked evidence strength and missing information, but errors in moderate, conflicting AT-NCD cases retained more confidence than accuracy justified.
links.quote: However, errors clustered in moderate, conflicting AT-NCD cases, where the model shifted toward DRCI and retained more confidence than empirical accuracy justified.

unlisted_practices: Psychophysics-inspired controlled benchmark measuring metacognitive sensitivity (AUROC2) of LLM confidence

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM metacognitive sensitivity and confidence calibration on a synthetic clinical vignette benchmark without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
